input_references.role: Independent constrained-area polygon, restriction type, and effective interval

metadata.goal: Analyze how vessels adapt their movement patterns when navigating around a constrained maritime area.
metadata.dataset_description: Constructed vessel movements around an independently supplied temporary maritime exclusion polygon in the west-Jutland offshore area.
metadata.source_note: Danish maritime geography is used as context; the visible trajectories and attributes are constructed derived data.
